dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Now where has Rozh run off to this time...? Ah, hello there, outlander. Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Avreliya, officer of the Druzhna, at your service. I'm currently carrying out patrol and supervisory duties.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: If you run into any trouble, such as being harassed by certain heavy-handed individuals, please feel free to ask me for help.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: As Her Majesty's most loyal sword and shield, the Druzhna will not just stand by. This is also a matter of preserving Snezhnaya's dignity. After all, our Fatui colleagues have never cared much for such things.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: *sigh* That was embarrassing. Praporshchik Rozhdansky is my fi— a friend I have known since childhood.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: He was born into a noble family, and even joined the Druzhna on the strength of his own talent. And yet he spends all day neglecting his duties, ignoring discipline, and idling about...!

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Take your eyes off him for a moment, and he will find some new ways to cause trouble! If he's not off flirting with young ladies, he's drinking with that lot outside the city...

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: If I hadn't been keeping an eye on him, who knows how far he would drag the Druzhna's discipline through the mud...!

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Ah... My apologies. I should not be burdening you with complaints. Just... please pretend you heard none of that.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Goodbye. If you run into any trouble, please come to me at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have something against the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Not at all. As fellow servants of Her Majesty, we should work together as one. And now with a crisis looming in the horizon, this is no time to dwell on old grievances.

dialogues.speaker: Avreliya
dialogues.text: Whether our Fatui colleagues understand that, however, is not for me to decide. As you can see, all I can do is govern myself, and remain ever loyal to Her Majesty.
